name: YJ YuHu Megaminx V2 M
reviews: Được mô tả là một trong những Megaminx nhanh nhất, cắt góc rất tốt
description: YJ YuHu Megaminx V2 (Magnetic) magnetic puzzle is the first megaminx in this price range to come equipped with magnets from the factory! The moderate-strength magnets add a nice weight to the puzzle, which helps to improve the overall stability of the puzzle and promotes smoother, more accurate turning.
